title: Thirty-second explanation
text: Grounded Action Map is a prototype for responsible humanitarian action intelligence. It connects sourced reporting, sector needs, organization transparency evidence, learning pathways, simulations, peacebuilding lenses, and future capacity so people can move from concern to careful, reviewed, responsible action.

title: Two-minute explanation
text: Start with the Gaza dashboard, where current humanitarian priorities are organized by sector with source badges and review labels. Open one sector to see what is happening now, what may come next, and what action pathways exist. Then inspect the Trust Evidence Layer and organization Transparency Passports. From there, build a learning pathway, practice a decision in the Simulation Lab, view the issue through the Peacebuilding Lens, and connect action to future capacity through the Living Map and Action Ripple Map. The prototype does not process donations, rank organizations, or publish unreviewed claims. It shows how concern can become responsible action through evidence, learning, safeguards, and human review.
